observation.command:
mkdir -p /tmp/kc-msg && cd /tmp/kc-msg
for f in messages messages_de; do
  curl -fsSL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/keycloak/keycloak/26.1.2/themes/src/main/resources/theme/base/messages/$f.properties" -o "$f.properties" && echo "OK $f $(wc -l < $f.properties)" || echo "FAIL $f"
done
echo "=== en special/length keys ==="
grep -iE "specialchar|invalidPasswordLength|lowerCase|upperCase|digit" messages.properties | head
echo "=== de existing ==="
grep -iE "specialchar|invalidPasswordLength|lowerCase|upperCase|digit" messages_de.properties | head
